name: Home: the Sim Lab banner

Debrief: score, best, missed, sources, next sim
Wrong answer: shown wrong, the right one lit, explained
One miss: 2 stars
Scan: four labels on the drawing
UV light: the scorpion glows
Picture choices: two drawings to choose from
Scan done: 3 stars
Alarm ID 1: the alarm plays by itself and is drawn
Alarm ID 2: the alarm plays by itself and is drawn
Alarm ID 3: the alarm plays by itself and is drawn
Smoke: 3 long beeps twice; CO: 4 short beeps twice; low battery: one chirp
Alarm ID: 3 stars
Leaving a sim silences it
CPR Beat: chest, pace gauge, target 100 to 120
While pushing: the pace shows live and says Good at 110
Steady 110 a minute: most pushes in the zone, 3 stars
Debrief keeps the real-CPR tip
Drill: suggests a meeting place when none is set
Drill running: the smoke alarm sounds
…and the clock runs
Stop: under 2 minutes is 3 stars, the alarm stops, the time is kept
Drill debrief: tips from the fire marshal
Three or more sims run: the quest is complete
Stars survive a restart (3 + 2 + 3 + 3 + 3 + 3 = 17)
Hub tiles show stars and the drill's best time
Home banner shows the progress
